crossRefs.note: The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”
There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.
Don’t answer a fool according to his folly, lest you also be like him.
Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own eyes.
“Isn’t my word like fire?” says Yahweh; “and like a hammer that breaks the rock in pieces?
But if all prophesy, and someone unbelieving or unlearned comes in, he is reproved by all, and he is judged by all.
And thus the secrets of his heart are revealed. So he will fall down on his face and worship God, declaring that God is…
Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.
For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul…
There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to…
He had seven stars in his right hand. Out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword. His face was like the sun…
Repent therefore, or else I am coming to you quickly, and I will make war against them with the sword of my mouth.
Out of his mouth proceeds a sharp, double-edged sword, that with it he should strike the nations. He will rule them…
At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, he who is to die shall be put to death. At the mouth of one witness…
But to the wicked God says, “What right do you have to declare my statutes, that you have taken my covenant on your…
“Don’t judge, so that you won’t be judged.
“Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within…
Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn…
You therefore who teach another, don’t you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn’t steal, do you steal?

translations.web: But when they continued asking him, he looked up and said to them, “He who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her.”
translations.bsb: When they continued to question Him, He straightened up and said to them, “Let him who is without sin among you be the first to cast a stone at her.”
translations.kjv: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
translations.asv: But when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
